levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «عن أبيه سليمان الديلمي» is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7)
The Imam speaks inside Sulayman's story («قال أبو عبد الله عليه السلام»): he is the last link, after the narrator (owner ruling 5)
Abu Basir enters and asks questions inside the story, but the saying is the Imam's teaching: he is not added as a link
The honorific «رحمه الله» and the blessings are left out
